comments.author: Mella
comments.body:
This quest I found quite hard to pull. I don't know the requirements but I'm sure it's more than just Arabic, I couldn't pull it until after 50,000 total fame, the first Imperial Quest completed, and 6th Knight. You must speak to Julia/Yuria, at Alexandria Tavern, several times, then the Shaman, several times, then Yuria/Julia again, several times. Then go kill Lamia/Ramia who has replaced the npc outside of Giza dungeon door (He's level 28 i think). Then report back to Alexandria Maritime Guild's mediator. You will then receive Harshaw/Hershel/Hashiu/Hasseu as a steward option next time you view your quarters information!

This quest is made really quite difficult cause the game can't decide what the characters are supposed to be called XD XD XD

Good luck everybody!
